appInfo.name: DeskFit
appInfo.description: Smart exercise reminders for healthier work days

releases.title: DeskFit 2.1
highlights: Right-click menu: right-click the menu bar icon to see your status, start or snooze a session, rest for today, or open Settings, Send Feedback, Check for Updates and About.
Shorter onboarding: three steps instead of four, with your working days, hours and reminder timing on one screen.
Cleaner panel: a flat panel without the title, a small status line when DeskFit isn't active, and a simpler weekly progress bar.
Clearer reminders: choose regular or random timing in Settings > Schedule, with a one-line summary of what you'll get.
Easier exercise library: each exercise shows its categories, search also matches categories, and steps are now optional when you add your own.

releases.title: DeskFit 2.0
highlights: The plant: your streak and progress grow a plant you look after, with stages, badges and a weekly target.
Notch mode: on a Mac with a notch, reminders and exercises appear in the notch. Menu bar only is still available.
New Settings: Schedule, Exercises, Progress and General, with a library you can edit and add your own exercises to.
Onboarding: a short four-step setup on first launch.
Diagnostics with opt-out: usage counts and crash reports help improve DeskFit, including the names of exercises you add. Turn them off during onboarding or in Settings > General.
